notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the damage sources you control will deal this turn.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Quest for Pure Flame.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
